pages.en: Lily has a toothache. "Too many sweets!" says Mum. They make an appointment with the dentist for Monday afternoon.
pages.zh: Lily 牙疼了。“糖吃太多了！”妈妈说。她们约了星期一下午看牙医。
pages.scene: Lily sitting at the kitchen table holding her cheek, her face sad and in pain, not smiling, a bowl of sweets in front of her, Mum behind her talking on the phone.

pages.en: Lily is a little afraid, but the dentist is very kind. He looks at her teeth and fixes the bad tooth. It doesn't hurt much.
pages.zh: Lily 有点害怕，可是牙医很和蔼。他看了她的牙，把坏牙补好了。不怎么疼。
pages.scene: A bright dentist's room, Lily sitting in the big dentist's chair with her mouth open, a kind dentist with a mirror smiling at her, Mum holding her hand.

pages.en: At home, Lily gives Tom a new toothbrush. "Brush your teeth twice a day," she says, "and don't eat too many sweets!" Tom laughs.
pages.zh: 回到家，Lily 给了 Tom 一把新牙刷。“每天刷两次牙，”她说，“别吃太多糖！”Tom 笑了。
pages.scene: Lily and Tom brushing their teeth together at the bathroom sink, both with blue toothbrushes and white foam, smiling at each other in the mirror.

questions.q: Lily's toothache is from too many sweets.
questions.zh: Lily 牙疼是因为吃了太多糖。
Lily 给了 Tom 什么？
